## Objetivo

Este notebook toma el resultado de la auditoría OSM amplia y construye un primer bloque
de variables candidatas `OSM -> ZONA777`.

En esta etapa el objetivo es:

- materializar un parquet de features OSM por `ZONA777`;
- dejar explícita la shortlist activa de `key=value`;
- auditar cobertura, rangos y densidades básicas;
- y separar variables prioritarias de variables en observación.

Todavía **no** se integran estas variables al modelo.

## Setup

```{python}
#| label: setup
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
import sys

import geopandas as gpd
import polars as pl

PROJECT_ROOT = Path.cwd()
if not (PROJECT_ROOT / "lib").exists() and (PROJECT_ROOT.parent / "lib").exists():
    PROJECT_ROOT = PROJECT_ROOT.parent
if str(PROJECT_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_ROOT))

from lib.osm_zona777 import (
    DEFAULT_OSM_ZONA777_SPECS,
    OSM_MICROINFRA_ZONA777_SPECS,
    OSMTagValueSpec,
    build_osm_spec_table,
    build_osm_zona777_outputs,
)
```

## Specs microinfraestructura candidata

Estas specs no se activan automáticamente en el bloque principal hasta revisar el
EDA en `02_eda/eda_osm_zona777.qmd`. Quedan acá para facilitar la siguiente ronda
si se decide materializarlas como variables model-ready.

```{python}
#| label: microinfra-candidate-specs
print("label: microinfra-candidate-specs")

OSM_MICROINFRA_CANDIDATE_SPECS = OSM_MICROINFRA_ZONA777_SPECS + (
    OSMTagValueSpec(
        "highway",
        "elevator",
        "osm_highway_elevator",
        "microinfra_sensitivity",
        "accessibility sensitivity; low mass",
    ),
)

df_microinfra_candidate_specs = build_osm_spec_table(OSM_MICROINFRA_CANDIDATE_SPECS)
with pl.Config(tbl_rows=-1, tbl_cols=-1, tbl_width_chars=1000):
    display(df_microinfra_candidate_specs)
```

## Helpers

```{python}
#| label: helpers
print("label: helpers")

def summarize_osm_feature_block(
    df_features: pl.DataFrame,
    df_specs: pl.DataFrame,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for spec in df_specs.to_dicts():
        feature_name = spec["feature_name"]
        count_col = f"{feature_name}_count"
        presence_col = f"{feature_name}_presence"
        density_col = f"{feature_name}_density_km2"
        rows.append(
            {
                "status": spec["status"],
                "key": spec["key"],
                "value": spec["value"],
                "feature_name": feature_name,
                "notes": spec["notes"],
                "nonzero_zonas_count": int(df_features.filter(pl.col(count_col) > 0).height),
                "pct_zonas_nonzero_count": float(100 * df_features.filter(pl.col(count_col) > 0).height / df_features.height),
                "total_count": int(df_features.select(pl.col(count_col).sum()).item()),
                "max_count": int(df_features.select(pl.col(count_col).max()).item()),
                "max_density_km2": float(df_features.select(pl.col(density_col).max()).item()),
                "mean_density_km2": float(df_features.select(pl.col(density_col).mean()).item()),
                "n_presence_ones": int(df_features.select(pl.col(presence_col).sum()).item()),
            }
        )
    return pl.DataFrame(rows).sort(["status", "nonzero_zonas_count", "total_count"], descending=[False, True, True])
```

## Construir bloque OSM por ZONA777

```{python}
#| label: build-osm-zona777-features
print("label: build-osm-zona777-features")
df_osm_zona777 = build_osm_zona777_outputs(
    osm_raw_path=RAW_OSM_PARQUET,
    zonas_path=ZONAS777_SHP,
    out_dir=OUT_DIR,
    specs=DEFAULT_OSM_ZONA777_SPECS,
)
print("✅ OSM ZONA777 features escritos en:", OUT_FEATURES)
print("✅ OSM ZONA777 specs escritos en:", OUT_SPECS)
print("✅ OSM ZONA777 summary escrito en:", OUT_SUMMARY)
print("shape:", df_osm_zona777.shape)
display(df_osm_zona777.head(5))
```

## Resumen del bloque OSM

```{python}
#| label: osm-zona777-feature-summary
print("label: osm-zona777-feature-summary")
df_osm_feature_summary = summarize_osm_feature_block(
    df_features=df_osm_zona777,
    df_specs=df_osm_specs,
)
with pl.Config(tbl_rows=-1, tbl_cols=-1, tbl_width_chars=1000):
    display(df_osm_feature_summary)
```

## Preview prioritarias

```{python}
#| label: osm-priority-preview
print("label: osm-priority-preview")
priority_feature_names = (
    df_osm_specs
    .filter(pl.col("status") == "priority")
    .get_column("feature_name")
    .to_list()
)
priority_cols = ["ZONA777", "AREA_KM2"]
for feature_name in priority_feature_names[:8]:
    priority_cols.extend(
        [
            f"{feature_name}_count",
            f"{feature_name}_presence",
            f"{feature_name}_density_km2",
        ]
    )
display(df_osm_zona777.select(priority_cols).head(10))
```
